name: ced_degoog_plugins
description: Degoog extensions by cedhuf — self-hosted integrations for your homelab stack.
author: cedhuf

plugins.name: Hister Slot
plugins.description: Integrates your personal [Hister](https://github.com/asciimoo/hister) history index into Degoog — shows an "In your index" panel alongside search results.

plugins.name: Karakeep Slot
plugins.description: Integrates your self-hosted [Karakeep](https://karakeep.app) bookmark manager into Degoog — shows an "In your bookmarks" panel alongside search results.

plugins.name: OhMyClean
plugins.description: Selectively hide or replace Degoog UI elements — footer, settings gear (home + results), search buttons, logo wordmark. Swap the button row for a minimal arrow, or just clean up what you don't use.

plugins.name: Logotype
plugins.description: Replace the Degoog logo with a custom text wordmark or your own image. Style your brand with font, color, and decorator options — all with a live preview. Manage via `!logo`.

engines.name: Hister Engine
engines.description: Native Hister search engine — results in a dedicated tab and via the `!hister` bang shortcut.

engines.name: Karakeep Engine
engines.description: Native Karakeep bookmark search engine — results in a dedicated tab and via the `!karakeep` bang shortcut.
